quarterly_data.quarter: YTL Power International press release: YTL AI Cloud Among Asia's First Cloud Providers to Achieve (05-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: YTL AI Cloud (wholly owned subsidiary of YTL Power International) achieved NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud status, which the company says makes it one of the first cloud infrastructure providers in Asia, and among the first NVIDIA Cloud Partners in Asia-Pacific, to complete the validation. The benchmark evaluated a 512-GPU environment across workloads including DeepSeek-V3, Llama 3.1, Qwen3 and Nemotron; the company says the platform met or exceeded NVIDIA's performance targets across all test phases. The infrastructure uses NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs with NVLink and Spectrum-X Ethernet, direct-to-chip liquid cooling and YTL's proprietary Cloud Orchestration Platform, housed in YTL's 1640 acre Green Data Center Park in Johor powered by an on-site solar facility.
